notes.title: Version 2.0 Update！
notes.notes:
Version 2.0 Update: New Anomalies and Improved Game Hints

Details:
1. Added 5 brand-new anomalies, each highly visible or with jump-scare elements (also removed 5 inconspicuous or irrelevant anomalies, making the game easier after this update. Note: If this isn’t your first playthrough and you want to see these new additions, make sure to enable “Reset Anomalies” to view the new content correctly).
2. Added hints to text sections, including new hints on the newspaper at the ending to help ensure you don’t miss these texts.
3. Fixed several in-game bugs.

If you encounter any issues, please let me know. : )
